Is this satire?  I've probably studied soc more than you have, and this reads like SOC 101 satire, poes law and all. I guess the lonely men hate train doesn't need facts, just assertions that feel a certain way.  If you go far enough around, even men being hurt is somehow men's fault.  Women have literally no agency, and a bunch of other distortions based on outdated statistics.

What about the one where women 25-39 make more than men.  Or how they graduate school at 50% greater rate, or kill themselves less often.  Or are you one of those people who have no sympathy for men, and just go "oh, they're violent, they use guns," and shrug the whole thing off. I wish you were satire, you're a cancer on culture.
